cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to our inn. First, apologise to the doorway for knocking after you arrived.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had to get here to knock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's an explanation, not an apology. It expected advance notice from your knuckles. Try again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, doorway. I did phone ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the telephone out of your defence. Now apologise for telling it first; the doorway should hear about its own visitors directly.

reason: Make the innkeeper correct the attempted apology and its defence, retaining impossible notice and priority expectations.
